content: I'd like to have some reproducible logs for some metaprogramming tools I'm working on. I was wondering, is there a way to turn Exprs into blobs (or a specific format) in such a way that I can export them and import them later?
It's possible to use a CompactedRegion to write a datastructure out to a file and then, later, read it back in — that's how oleans work! Does that meet your use case?
Very neat, I'll look into CompactedRegion, thank you!
